mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.25%, it signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.25%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts below 1050.0 and labor market growth below 0.5% signals weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high labor market tightness regimes (UNRATE below 5.0%), strong employment supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the prior 6 months indicates robust manufacturing activity and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO has increased over the prior 6 months, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1000.0 thousand units, it signals housing market weakness and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1000.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous inflation rise above 2.0% (CPIAUCSL > 2.0) and interest rate stability above 0.25% (FEDFUNDS > 0.25%) signals inflation-driven monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In industrial production contraction regimes (INDPRO below 105.0), manufacturing slowdown reduces corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
